description: Compensatory levy for unfilled jobs for severely disabled people under German law (Ausgleichsabgabe, §§ 154, 160 SGB IX), years 2024 to 2026. Takes the jobs and the severely disabled employees per month (or one value for all months) and returns required places, employment rate, rate per place and month, the levy and the 31 March deadline. Only employers with 20 or more jobs on annual average are affected. Germany only.

arbeitsplaetze.description: Jobs (Arbeitsplätze) of 18 or more hours per week without apprentices and fixed terms up to 8 weeks: one value for every month or 12 values January to December

jahr.description: Calendar year of employment, default the current year

schwerbehinderte.description: Severely disabled or equivalent employees as counted by the employment agency (angerechnet): one value or 12 monthly values, default 0

name: ausgleichsabgabe

ergebnis.description: Result of the tool; its fields differ per tool
